program_overview: 36-Week Electrical Systems, Workforce Development & National Certification Preparation Program
Understand It. Wire It. Test It. Troubleshoot It. Master the Code. Power Your Future.

The 36-Week Electrical Technology Program is a comprehensive career and technical education and workforce-development program designed to prepare students for entry-level employment, electrical apprenticeships, postsecondary technical education, industry credentials, and applicable certification examinations.
Students progress from fundamental electrical theory and safety into residential, commercial, and introductory industrial electrical systems.
